decisions.rationale: 100% backward compatibility for all existing diagrams and gallery tests
Explicit edge parameters override diagram defaults which override system defaults

decisions.decision: corner_radius=None inherits diagram default, 0.0 forces sharp corners
decisions.rationale: Distinguishes unset edges from explicitly sharp corners

decisions.decision: Diagram.configure(routing=...) supports runtime reconfiguration with cache invalidation
decisions.rationale: Allows dynamic updates and marks _is_solved = False
Dispatches to CurveRouter, OrthogonalRouter, or direct/polyline based on edge type

decisions.decision: Route edges first in run_layout(), then expand canvas via _grow_canvas
decisions.rationale: Gives canvas growth full visibility into edge waypoints and curve extrema
Supports manually routed or file-loaded waypoints without re-routing

decisions.decision: Pass elements + diagram.groups as obstacles to edge routers
decisions.rationale: Ensures complete deflection coverage around grouped containers

decisions.decision: Analytical curve bounding boxes via CubicBezier.bbox()
decisions.rationale: Exact derivative roots avoid sampling errors in canvas bounds

decisions.decision: Framing translation translates both elements and edge waypoints
decisions.rationale: Eliminates clipping when curves arch into negative coordinates
Preserves user-specified width/height unless content overflows
